## 1. Start with the inspection records

The local authority fire inspector has conducted the initial inspection and will have identified some visual deficiencies of the building. This information should be included in the response to be submitted with the BCA.

The Fire and Rescue Service gives the owner and occupiers 28 days to make good the visual defects so it is recommended that the consultant commences their work immediately upon receipt of the inspection report from FRS to minimise the risk of prosecution.

Because of the tight timescales involved, it is critical that the consultant establishes which Building Control documents are available. This document register should be included in the response.
